name: Parts and stock
summary: A fast counter-top stock app: every item is a row with big minus / count / plus buttons (each tap is logged, quick taps merge into one line, Undo in a toast), low and out-of-stock rows get a coloured edge, a pill and a fill gauge, a warning banner and a Reorder badge; the Reorder tab groups what to buy by supplier with editable amounts, Text / Email / Share order buttons, 'mark as ordered' and 'delivery came in'; item pages have a huge quantity, Use / Receive / Set count, value, margin, days of stock left and full history; plus an Activity log, suppliers with phone/email, CSV import/export with a column check, printable count sheet and reorder list with the letterhead, photos, and JSON backup. Starts empty with a welcome card and 'Try it with sample data'.

sections.name: view-stock
sections.what: Stock tab: date eyebrow, h1 Stock, summary, sample note, welcome card (add first item / import / sample), low-stock banner with Reorder button, 4 stats (stock value at cost with retail, items + units, Low and Out cards that filter), sticky search, All / Low / Out switch + sort, category chips, the item rows
sections.edit: Rewrite the welcome card's words for this trade (for example 'Know which parts are on the shelf'). Keep every data-text / data-slot / data-act attribute

sections.name: view-item
sections.what: One item (route #/stock/ID): category eyebrow, name, part number and location, Edit; hero card with photo or 'Add a photo', big - / quantity / +, status pill, minimum, gauge, Use and Receive buttons, 'Set the exact count'; stats (value at cost, unit cost, sale price + margin, used in 30 days + days left); details with supplier Call / Text / Email; history; Delete
sections.edit: Usually no change; rename labels such as 'Location' to the owner's words ('Bin', 'Van')

sections.name: view-reorder
sections.what: Reorder tab: summary with estimated cost, Print, one card per supplier with order lines (status, ordered pill, amount stepper), estimated cost, Text order / Email / Share, Mark as ordered, Delivery came in, Add phone or email; empty state when nothing is low
sections.edit: Usually no change. The order message is built by orderText() in app.js; the closing line is a setting

sections.name: view-activity
sections.what: Activity tab: used and received this month (units and cost), Export CSV, search, kind chips, changes grouped by day

sections.name: view-more
sections.what: More tab: suppliers list (+ Add), import from CSV or paste, export items, print count sheet, print reorder list, backup download/copy and restore from file or paste, space used, settings (currency, line at the end of every order), sample data, erase all, footer
sections.edit: Set the default currency and order line in app.js SETTINGS if the owner told you

sections.name: pieces
sections.what: Repeated templates: stock row, history row, day group, supplier order card, order line, supplier row, category chip
sections.edit: Restyle freely; keep data-text / data-slot names

sections.name: sheet-item
sections.what: Add / edit item form: photo, name, part number, location, category, on hand (stepper), minimum (stepper), unit cost, sale price, supplier, notes
sections.edit: Rename fields to the owner's words; do not remove name, on hand or minimum

sections.name: sheet-move
sections.what: Use / Receive / Set count sheet: big stepper, quick amounts 1-25, live 'now / after' line, note
sections.edit: Change the quick amounts if the owner works in other pack sizes

sections.name: sheet-supplier
sections.what: Supplier form: name, phone for texting orders, email for orders, notes

sections.name: sheet-receive
sections.what: Delivery sheet: one amount per item of a supplier's order, note

sections.name: sheet-mapping
sections.what: Column check for item imports (10 fields), preview, new vs updated counts; paste form

sections.name: print
sections.what: Printable document with the business letterhead ({{business}}, {{address}}, {{phone}}, {{email}}) used by the reorder list and the count sheet
sections.edit: Delete the address line if the owner has no public address

behaviors: all data in the phone's browser storage (AK.store 'inventory-tracker' for items/history/suppliers/settings, 'inventory-tracker-ui' for filters, 'inventory-tracker-photos' for photos and thumbnails), namespaced by {{slug}}; survives reloads
low = at or under the minimum, out = 0; reorder amount fills back up to twice the minimum unless the owner changes it; a delivery that lifts an item above its minimum clears 'ordered'
every change writes a history line (use, receive, count, added, imported) with time, note and unit cost; quick +/- taps within 2 minutes merge; stock never goes below 0; Undo on every change
orders to suppliers: sms: and mailto: links with the order text (AK.sms / AK.mail), native share sheet (AK.share), copy

CSV import from file or paste with a column check (English plus common German/Spanish/French headers), matches by part number then name, updates or adds; sample items are removed by the first real import; CSV export imports back unchanged
photos via AK.photo, resized, with a small thumbnail for the list; space used is shown and new photos are refused before storage is full
printable count sheet (by location, with boxes) and reorder list with estimated totals
backup download (with photos) or copy (without), restore from file or pasted text, checked and cleaned before it replaces anything
index.html?sample opens with the sample data (for previews); window.StockApp exposes the data and helpers for scripting
style_notes: Works with every style, light or dark. Tested at 320, 390 and 1280 with midnight-neon, clinical-clean, workshop-industrial, soft-pastel, neo-brutalist, editorial-serif, poster-bold and high-contrast-sport. Status uses appkit's contrast-tuned ok/warn/bad colours plus words (Low, Out) and an edge stripe, never colour alone. The only lint warning is appkit's expected 'more than one accent colour family'.
